column2: comes up grey over the waste.
thin light. and we are still here.
the clock turns. something out there woke up.
the clock turns again. the waste is paying attention.
the clock turns. nothing out here is sleeping now.
the clock has run out of patience with us.
takes up the road with us.
walks out, and does not look back.
goes down. and does not get up.
the sky clears. small mercy, and brief.
rain comes in thin and cold.
a storm walks in off the flats.
the rain turns wrong. chem burn.
strangle fog settles in the low ground.
fog closes the world to arm's length.
steps off the map, and into the dark.
step right up. step right up.
the weight behind you lifts. it has lost the thread.
whatever was following has turned away.
the air goes quiet. for now.
something out there has your scent.
the wind changed. it knows which way you went.
you left too much of yourself on that ground.
it is eating the ground behind you.
your work rots as fast as you can do it.
it has stopped looking. it is coming.
there is no track to follow now. only you.
it knows the shape of you.
